# Through the Ring PRO

> A one-tap arcade game for iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later). Tap to jump, fly through each ring to open the wall. Paid once, no ads, no tracking, no account, works offline.

- [Home](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/): what the game is
- [Support](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/support.html): get the game back, report a bug, common questions
- [Privacy](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/privacy.html): the game collects nothing; last updated 6 October 2026
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1203310957)

Version 2.1 is submitted to Apple for review. It supports portrait play on both Duo displays; simulator checks cover large text, Settings/practice, results, pause/resume and closed/partially open/open transitions. Physical Duo testing is pending. Do not describe version 2.1 as released until Apple approves it.
